The '''ATX-5''' was an Class 4 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] engine made by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]]. It cost 4,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and weighed 10 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]].
